Small ceramic bathroom sink with faucet. This sink model has all plumbings exposed.

Rare nine piece collection.Nine stoneware vases in eggshell glaze by Gunnar Nylund for Rörstrand, Sweden.Scandinavian elegance designed and manufactured in the '50s and '60s. All the vases are first assortment.The tallest vase measures 30.8 cm / 12 1/8 in Source: https://www.1stdibs.com/
Gunnar Nylund
Gunnar Nylund (1 May 1914–1997) was a Swedish ceramic designer since the 1930s, best known as the artistic director of Rörstrand, and was already a well-established ceramic artist in Denmark first at the Bing & Grøndahl Porcelain factory in Copenhagen 1925–28. Later, in 1928, in collaboration with chemist Nathalie Krebs, he started a ceramics workshop, which became Saxbo in 1930, which kept making his stoneware until 1932. Nylund worked for Rörstrand from 1931–1955, the majority of the time as artistic director. He became well known for his new matte feldspar glazed stoneware in hare's fur and crystal glazes and for his stoneware animal sculptures. Source: Wiki
Model
File units are centimeters and the model is scaled to represent real-life object's dimension
Modeled in 3ds max 2018 and rendered with V-Ray 5.1.3 using VrayTriplanar
Materials Included with 4K Textures 
The model comes as Editable Poly with group and layers named properly
No lights, cameras and render/scene setup are included
Please contact me for further info or instructions
Thank you!

description_text:
zbrush production, blender rendering. The model polygon face amount has been reduced and optimized in zbrush.The model is single subtools, and closed solid , and the inner and outer layers can be separated.Blender pure digital material rendering, also provides material baking PBR texture, PNG format, 4096 precision.By the way, li vessels are cooking vessels similar to modern cooking POTS. The earliest reported li vessels can be traced back to the Neolithic Age. Pottery vessel 1i was the earliest. Bronze vessel 1I appeared in the Shang and Zhou dynasties. Tripod tripod tripod is the basic feature of li. Its structure is generally divided into upper and lower parts. Tripod tripod is a square or round vessel with two ears on the upper part and three hollow feet on the lower part. Because the three feet are hollow, like pockets, and joined together.
Taotie pattern four-legged li was unearthed in 1981 in Chenggu County, Hanzhong City, Shaanxi Province. Different from common three-legged li, I am the only four-legged li found in China so far. Geometrically, the three points were on the same plane anyway, but adding another point to the plane where the three points were would have been a rare and unique thing to do in the foundry process of the time.
In the imitation design, I cut holes in the sole of the foot to conduct water ventilation, which can be printed as a succulent flower pot decoration.

Castle 18-03 by Roll & Hill | 3d model produced by Design Connected | www.designconnected.com
This 3d model is part of the highly acclaimed Design Connected collection featuring 6500+ carefully picked exclusive furnishings. Check out our full range of 3d models for more mid-century icons, contemporary classics and designer masterpieces.
All Design Connected 3d models are originally created in 3ds Max and V-Ray renderer.
Our in-house team of 3d artists handle all further remodelling, materials conversions and other adaptations to deliver best possible visual and technical quality of all the additional file formats and renderers we offer. 
Files units are centimeters and all models are accurately scaled to represent real-life object's dimensions.
Our models come as a single editable mesh or poly object (or as group for rigged models or where displace modifier has been used) properly named and positioned in the center of coordinate system. No lights, cameras and render/scene setup are included unless otherwise stated in the particular model’s description.

  - Autodesk 3ds Max  2011 or above-- VRay-- Mental Ray-- Scanline-- Corona-- Maxwell

  - OBJ and FBX

Hi-res 3D model of a coffee grinder modelled in maya. Preview images rendered with VRay.

  - high resolution 4K PBR textures (png), suitable for close up shots and animation

If you need help setting up materials in other render engines feel free to contact me!

3ds Max - Corona

OBJ
ABC

description_text:
Eurocosmo Vessel 60 Set by Grohe | 3d model produced by Design Connected | www.designconnected.com
This 3d model is part of the highly acclaimed Design Connected collection featuring 6500+ carefully picked exclusive furnishings. Check out our full range of 3d models for more mid-century icons, contemporary classics and designer masterpieces.
All Design Connected 3d models are originally created in 3ds Max and V-Ray renderer.
Our in-house team of 3d artists handle all further remodelling, materials conversions and other adaptations to deliver best possible visual and technical quality of all the additional file formats and renderers we offer. 
Files units are centimeters and all models are accurately scaled to represent real-life object's dimensions.
Our models come as a single editable mesh or poly object (or as group for rigged models or where displace modifier has been used) properly named and positioned in the center of coordinate system. No lights, cameras and render/scene setup are included unless otherwise stated in the particular model’s description.
AVAILABLE FILE FORMATS

  - Sketchup  8 or above 

  - Autodesk 3ds Max  2011 or above-- VRay-- Mental Ray-- Scanline-- Corona-- Maxwell

  - OBJ and FBX 

  - Cinema4D  R16 or above-- Adv. / Physical-- V-Ray 1.9-- V-Ray 3.4

ADDITIONAL FILE FORMATS UPON REQUEST

  - ARCHICAD R16 or above

  - Autodesk 3ds 

  - Abvent Artlantis 

  - Rhinoceros 

  - Autodesk DWG 

  - Maya 

  - Lightwave 

  - Collada 

PRODUCT DESCRIPTIONBrand: Grohe, Germanyhttp://www.grohe.comDesigner:  N/ADesign Connected ID: 8810
BEFORE PURCHASEWe highly recommend that you download few of our FREE 3D MODELS and test if they work well with your 3d software before making a purchase.
ABOUT THE IMAGERYPreviews rendered in 3dsMax using VRay. Please note that the studio scenes and light and environment settings are not included.
SUPPORTIf you have any questions about how to use Design Connected 3d models, please contact us via Support.
Thank you for purchasing Design Connected models!

description_text:
One of Malay traditional fishing methods that were used back in the days. The bubu is made of bamboo, with rattan rings as frames.  Bubu also can be called as 'traps' or 'guiding barrier'. It can be carried with hand or to shoulder depending on the size. It is designed to work without attendance.
This type of fishing normally known and used by the local fishermans who lived near the sea, or river which usually placed on shallow water. It also works in the pond. 
The way Bubu works is by placing the bait inside the body of bubu and letting the fish to take the bait on a one-way path only through the funnel. While the other side is the door of the bubu for collecting the trapped fishes.

description_text:
Cutting Board

  - Model unwrapped manually to make most efficient use of the UV space

  - Normal map was baked from a high poly model to provide great detail while minimizing the polygon count

  - PBR pipeline acceptable

  - No special plug-ins needed to use this product

  - Polygons are all quads or tris, no n-gons

  - The model has been tested in UE4 and Unity as well.

Presentation Images
  - Final Images are rendered in Marmoset Toolbag 3 (metallic/roughness workflow), specially to show this model in realtime rendering, like in engines of videogames.
Model

  - This model is suitable for real-time 3D simulations like games.

  - Triangles: 1968

  - Points: 984

  - Units used: Centimeters

  - Up Axis: Y

Textures

  - The model is fully textured and detailed enough for close-up renders

  - (.png format)(4096x4096 size) 

  - Base_Color (Diffuse)

  - Normal

  - Metallic

  - Roughness

  - Additional Texture : Ambient Occlusion

File formats

  - Maya ASCII File (Autodesk Maya 2018)

  - OBJ (Multi Format)

  - FBX Format

Hope you like it!

description_text:
Archibald Knox Pewter Clock for Liberty & Co.
The model is made in 3DS Max. No 3rd party plugins is used. The model is made out of one object with 6 different materials IDs. All materials that is used is either standard or Raytrace. All materials is proper named. One bitmap is used. It is named clockbackground.bmp and can be found in materials.rar archive. An UVW map modifier has been added.
In order to animate the clock, a working pivot had been adjusted. Otherwise detach the needles.
The picture above have been rendered with MentalRay using daylight system. Other applications and lights will give other result.
The model is native till 3DS Max, in other formats the materials might not work.

description_text:
Game ready low-poly Kitchen Pots and Pans models with PBR textures for game engines/renderers.
This product is intended for game/real time/background use. This model is not intended for subdivision. Renders done in Marmoset Toolbag 3. Default render in Blender will NOT look like the preview images. The Marmoset Toolbag scene is included.
The textures in the embedded Marmoset preview are somewhat compressed. The textures you get when you purchase this product have better quality.
||SPECS||

  - Geometry is triangulated to ensure best shading.

  - Model unwrapped manually to make most efficient use of the UV space.

  - All materials and objects named appropriately.

  - Scaled to approximate real world size.

  - Tested in Marmoset Toolbag 3(see renders).

  - Tested in Unreal Engine 4.

  - Tested in Unity Engine.

  - Unity and Unreal Engine 4 projects included.

  - No special plugins needed.

  - .dae, .abc, .stl, .obj and .fbx versions exported from Blender 2.83.

|| Textures ||
4096x4096 textures:

  - General PBR Metallic/Roughness  textures: BaseColor, Metallic, Roughness, Normal(DirectX), Normal(OpenGL), AO.

  - Unity Textures: Albedo, MetallicSmoothness, Normal(OpenGL), AO.

  - Unreal Engine 4 textures: BaseColor, OcclusionRoughnessMetallic, Normal(DirectX).

  - PBR Specular/Glossiness textures: Diffuse, Specular, Glossiness, Normal(DirectX), Normal(OpenGL), AO.

All textures in png format. Substance Painter source files also available in the extra downloads so that you can easily alter the textures as you wish with Substance Painter.

description_text:
This is a house based on the project of architect Moon Hoon. It has this interesting worm shape and it's suppose to be a fun design and be diferent among other houses in the area.All the interior walls are built and some stairs were added as well. The top floor doesn't have doors, but those can be easily created by coping the ones downstairs. All the house have proper textures and materials.Vray 1.40 was used to make the materials and lighting(vray sun).Some household items that can be seen in the preview images were deleted in the final files because those items belong to another company. The bookshelf is in the file.INCLUDES:
 • detailed house  with materials and textures, ready to render with vray .
 • FBX file that can be imported in other 3d programs.
 • OBJ  file that can be imported in other 3d programs.I hope you like it and if you buy this item and need help, make sure to contact me.

Steam hot dogs to perfection with this Paragon 8020 Dog Hut hot dog steamer! Ideal for convenience stores, concession stands, and vending carts, this hot dog steamer features a heavy duty 20 gauge stainless steel construction as well as eye-catching graphics on both sides for front-counter or rear-counter merchandising. This unit not only accommodates any size hot dogs and sausages, but it allows them to be cooked simultaneously. Plus, dishwasher safe, removable product trays and sliding doors make clean up simple and easy. 
This hot dog steamer has a submersible heavy duty stainless steel heating element that will shut off when the water in the 8 quart water reservoir drops below a certain level. For added versatility, an adjustable thermostat allows this unit to operate in a wide variety of cooking and holding conditions. 
The Paragon 8020 Dog Hut hot dog steamer has a maximum capacity of 200 hot dogs and 42 buns. It requires a 120V, 1200W electrical connection and is ETL, CE, CSA, UL, and NSF Listed. Please consult the Specification Sheet for additional details.

description_text:
Symbioso repair part for 30mm diameter circular wooden part. Look for other dimensions on my store or ask for a custom size for no extra charge!
Symbioso is a repair part designed to fix a broken wooden element. Its role is to join and keep the two parts togheter, while gluing or forever, as the final result needs. It adopt 3D printing technology to provide everyday life a helping hand, so it will created with few euros and fix the broken part, that may lead to trashing the whole broken object.
An example of its use, is a chair leg, as happened to us. While playing with the chair, it got broken, and we were close to trash the whole Ikea chair, for a value of 60€, plus all the travels to the dump and the closest Ikea store to find another one, to match the room design. So, having access to a basic PLA 3D printing machine (RepRap) we decided to find a good looking solution. Based on few years of experience in printing PLA plastic functional parts for robotics prototyping, we designed and printed this object, to be then declined to different objects and sizes.
The use is very simple, print it following the 3D printing setup config datas given in a txt file you'll find in model download section, slide it on your wooden section, join the broken part (cleaned a bit to allow the best match) with some glue as well (optional). Keep the break line in the middle. After that, use some wood slef-threading screws to fix Symbioso to the wooden parts.  Et voilà, you are done.
Please, keep in mind that you will always need a bit of tolerances when printing your parts. 3D models provided have 2mm tolerance to make the sliding process possible and easier.

Frame from Skagerak is a bowl reduced to the skeleton. The Frame bowls form was inspired by the framework of a wooden ship. The form lifts off of the table and is decorative and functional.Fruits, vegetables and other small things find their place in the Frame bowl. The bowls content is always visible because of the spaces between the wooden bars. Frame is an example for a loosely and transparent design made of wood.The Frame bowl consists of high quality teak wood. The main idea behind Frame was to manufacture as much as possible from as little material as possible. This is a product process-project that uses resources that would be lost other ways.

description_text:
This Stock Pot is a high quality, photorealistic 3D model. It is suitable for visual production such as design visualization, advertising, broadcast, high-res film close-ups, forensic presentation, etc. 
Model is made up of all quads mesh with holding/support edges, suitable for Subdivision.
Native 3D application is Blender 2.79. 
ZIP archive contains:

  - BLEND file. Subdivision Surface Modifier active.

  - OBJ_basemesh file. This is the base mesh version.

  - OBJ_highpoly file. This is with Subdivision Modifier applied.

  - FBX_basemesh file. This is the base mesh version.

  - FBX_highpoly file. This is with Subdivision Modifier applied.

  - 1 preview image.Note: 

  - OBJ and FBX meshes are all quads geometry, not triangulated. 

  - OBJ has its .MTL file.You also have the option to convert the .BLEND to an exchange format with your preferred setting by using Blender (it is totally free).

Features:

  - Professional high quality model that has real world scale (Metric).

  - All quad mesh with holding edges, suitable for subdivision.

  - Clean edge flow and optimized topology is used for maximum polygon efficiency.

  - Subsurf Modifier is active in .BLEND file, you can go as high or as low poly as you wish.

  - Objects have UVs. 

  - Model uses Blender's PBR shaders.

  - All objects, meshes and materials has meaningful and matching names.

  - No part-name confusion when importing several models into a scene.

  - No extra third-party plug-ins needed.

Additional Notes:

  - Model's main parts are presented as separate objects. This allows standard parts of the model to be easily selected for manipulation, and materials can be easily modified or swapped out.

  - Standard parts of the model has been grouped and parented to an Empty. The Empty is placed at the base of the model so it can be easily selected and positioned in the way you need. Just select the Empty to move and position the model.Note: Empty/Parent cannot be exported to OBJ, please use the FBX or Blend file.

  - Lights, camera and background are not included to avoid clutters.

  - Preview images are rendered with Blender Cycles with Subdivision Level 2.

Specification
Stock pots sizes are approximately 8 cm, 12 cm and 16 cm.Total objects: Each model contains 4 separate objects parented to an Empty.Total vertices and faces per stock pot:

  - Subdivision level 0 = 2438 vertices and 2400 faces.

  - Subdivision level 1 = 9672 vertices and 9600 faces.

The models use only procedural materials. No image textures needed.
Exchange formats are FBX (7.4 binary) and OBJ, all quads geometry.Depending on the application used, may need to reassign materials and might not render like the preview images.
This product has been checked and tested to ensure you get a high quality product.
Thank you very much for choosing my model.I look forward to continuously working with you in the future.
Have a great day, cheers!

description_text:
Bottle Grinder by Menu  made with 3Dmax and Vray. 
"Steering away from the predictable grinder, the Norm 'Bottle Grinder' is not what you expect to see in a salt and pepper grinder. The form, shaped more like a bottle, cleverly tricks the user to encourage a more playful and experimental interaction with the product. The powerful ceramic mechanism makes the grinder easy to operate and perfect for trying out more than just salt and pepper including spices and grains, nuts, seeds or dried fruits. You simply open them, fill them with delicious ingredients and close them again. Simple as that.
The unique, inverted design ensures that whatever you fill them with only sprinkles out when you grind, leaving no trace on the table or in the kitchen. The Grinders have a bottle-like shape, which is also important to the whole experience. Designer Kasper Rønn, “From a shape like this, you’d expect the content to be something liquid like oil or dressing, you’re not at all expecting dried up spices or nuts. We used this shape to surprise and somewhat trick the users. Sometimes people need a bit of a surprise in order to change their habits”. Menu Bottle Grinders have a rounded base that fits perfectly into the hands, and have a rubber surface that’s easy to grip and to clean. They come in a range of beautiful, soft Scandinavian colors. Bon appétit."
The model has a fully textured, detailed design that allows for close-up renders, and was originally modeled in 3ds Max 2018 and rendered with V-Ray.

description_text:
|| Black Titanium Knife ||
Black Titanium Knife, Game Ready asset is a high quality, low poly asset originally modeled in 3DS Max 2017.
The normal map was baked from a high poly model in Substance Painter 2019, making this product look very detailed without using many polygons. This product is intended for game/real time/ usage. This model is not intended for subdivision.
The renders and wireframes were done in Marmoset Toolbag 3.
||SPECS||
Low Poly Model:
All the main objects are separately and named correctly for an easy usage.
-This Asset is designed to be modular and ready for animation. Pivot points are centered or positioned where the object is supposed to rotate.
Includes: .obj, .max, .fbx, .3ds files.
.obj,.fbx and .3ds versions exported from 3ds Max 2017 .
An Unreal Engine 4 project is also included with textures. Ready to be used in your game.
An Unity package is also available.
|| Geometry ||
Total:
615 Total Polys
679 Total Verts
1.354 Total Tris
Model unwrapped manually to make most efficient use of the UV space.
Model scaled to approximate real world size. All materials and objects named appropriately.
Tested in Marmoset Toolbag 3 (see renders).
No special plug-ins needed to use this product.
|| Textures ||
Textures for Unity 5 and Unreal Engine 4 can be downloaded.
Textures in .targa format:
2k texture set (Basecolor, ambient occlusion, metallic, roughness, normal)

description_text:
This model is a high-end, photorealistic 3D model, that will help you to add realism to your project. The model is highly accurate and based on the manufacturer's original dimensions and technical data.
The model was initially created and fully textured in Blender 2.91, then rendered using Cycles.
All geometry and visual aspects of the model are optimized to give you the highest possible quality. There is no post-production used on any of the renders you see.
A clean and optimized topology is used for maximum polygon efficiency. The model is fully sub-dividable to increase mesh smoothness if needed. Polygon and vertice data are given without subdivided. All textures and materials are tailored and applied for high-quality render results. Some or all of the materials and textures may be made with Blender's shader nodes. You will get the best results in Blender.
No extra plugins are required for this model. Lights and cameras are not included in the scene.
If this model has stl extension in the file list, stl files have not been tested by printing. If you have any questions while printing, feel free to contact me.

Raku ware (楽焼, raku-yaki) is a type of Japanese pottery traditionally used in Japanese tea ceremonies, most often in the form of chawan tea bowls. It is traditionally characterised by being hand-shaped rather than thrown, fairly porous vessels, which result from low firing temperatures, lead glazes and the removal of pieces from the kiln while still glowing hot. Stemed antique wine glass in art deco style. The stem made of wore old, a bit scratched and oxidated golden metal with some inlaid orange gemstones. description_text:
Hi everyone!
This is an interesting 2-in-1 mould design. It is an apollo model that makes a comfortable silicone rubber broom/rake/mop handle.See the video of the design and build here - https://youtu.be/x_w8o-u4QrI
All the pieces will print without supports.To make a Broom buddy, follow these steps after printing the mould:
1 - Mix up a batch of proto-putty (silicone with food coloring as a      curing agent and corn starch as a filler/anti-sticky....stuff)      See Grant Thompson's video on how to make proto-putty here - https://youtu.be/7fwytA5r2Mw
2 - Roll the proto-putty into a blob the size of the mould cavity.      Place it in the mould, avoiding getting it between the mating surfaces.
3-  Assemble the mould and fit the alignment ring and cap.
3 - Locate and push the plunger all the way in. Do not block the vent holes.      Excess putty should ooze out of the holes.
4 - wait 20-30 min and dissasemble. A flat screwdriver may be necessary.
---Voilla!, a Broom buddy!---

description_text:
This household smoke detector is a great addition to any interior visualization scene where you are really trying to achieve full detail and photorealism. Smoke detectors are one of those household fixtures we take for granted when we see them but make a scene feel complete and believable. The smoke detector is set up for PBR rendering in cycles + Eevee and is textured in substance painter. 
The model is optimized in Blender using the subdivision surface modifier so you can set the desired level of detail and keep your scene efficient. The Node system is set up to be simple and easy to use with a clearly labeled slider that controls the level of wear and tear on the model. The file also includes an OBJ version of the model and the full 4k textures

description_text:
Model of a Viking Age (750-1050 AD) comb made from bone with a basic pattern carved into it.
Combs is a very common type of find on Viking Age archaeological excavations. They were usually made of bone or antler and are found both in graves and settlement contexts. They seem to have been a common personal accessory and were often decorated, sometimes even with runic inscriptions. 
The model has 2K PBR-textures built to real-world scale (metric system). The model was created using Blender and Substance Painter. Preview images were rendered with Iray.
Polygon Count
4300 vertices
4240 faces
8588 triangles  
File Formats
The model is available in the following file formats:
Autodesk FBX (.fbx)
OBJ (.obj)
Collada (.dae)
3D Studio (.3ds)
Blender v2.79 (.blend)  
Materials & Textures
The model is UV-mapped with a single material and a set of physics based textures (PBR MetalRough). 
The textures are not baked into the model, but are saved as png-files with a resolution of 2048 x 2048 pixels (8 bits) in the subfolder PBR textures:
Viking comb_Comb_BaseColor.png
Viking comb_Comb_Height.png
Viking comb_Comb_Metallic.png
Viking comb_Comb_Normal.png
Viking comb_Comb_Roughness.png

description_text:
Discover the right offset value to make your parts model to fit!
Have you ever printed or designed a 2+ parts model to make it fit together and after printed you realized it doesn't fit?
With this little tool you can find the right offset/gap value in milimeters, between parts so you can design your model parts to fit together without post processing parts (sanding). This tool discards the use of any software or slicer to try discovering the correct offset value.
It consists of 2 pieces:

  - A male pin that have a smaller diameter of 3mm.

  - A base/plate with 22 holes with increasing diameters. the smaller hole has 3.10mm and each hole increases its diameter by 0.02mm until the biggest hole, 3.52mm.

The values increases as:  3.10->3.12->3.14->3.16->3.18->3.20->3.22->3.24->3. 26->3.28->3.30->3.32->3.34->3.36->3.38->3.40->3.42->3.44->3.46->3.48->3.50->3.52mm
How to use:

  - The smallest hole (3.10mm) is the inner hole located at the LEFT side of the number 3.10 (in the plate) or base of the arrow. 

  - The outter hole at the LEFT side of the 3.10mm hole is the 3.32mm hole.

  - The increase in hole sizes occurs in the anti anticlockwise way, so the inners holes goes from 3.10mm to 3.30mm and the outter holes goes from 3.32mm to 3.52mm.

Insert the male pin at the holes. try first at the bigger holes, decrease and try inserting it each time in smaller holes until the male pin fits tight to a specif hole
Example: If the male pin fits tight in the 3,20mm hole and is the smallest hole which it can be inserted, so 3,20mm minus 3mm (male pin) equals to 0.20mm. At this example 0.20mm is the offset value that you should use to design you model parts to fit.
Realize that with this tool you will find the correct offset value according with different printers, configuration, temperature, filament brand or filament type your models parts will have different offset value.
Printing recomendation/tested for the tool will vary according with your filament type:

  - Use infill porcentages of 0% for both male pin and plate holes.

  - To print the male pin I suggest you to print 2 units placed with a big distance between them and using cooling fan, this way each layer will have enough time to hardening/cooling layers to get a better resolution/quality for the male pin.I will be avaliable in case of any doubts. Thanks

description_text:
This modern Tea, Coffee, and Sugar storage set comes in three differant colours, with seperate, removable lids.
The set is built to real world scale so it can be dropped straight into any project without any ajustment. Though, if ajustments are needed this can be done in the native blend file.
The download files are organized into three downloadable folders, being; Textures, Other Formats, and Native blend file. This is to improve convenience and organization when downloading the set. 
The storage canisters are empty, this way if they are being used in an animation you may add your own fully interactable contents for added realism. Likewise if the set is being used as a background prop, you will not have to deal with unnecessary polys.
If you have any questions about this set feel free to ask, or you can check out my other content on Instagram, Facebook, and twitter.

***************************** Brushed Metal Cafetiere French Press *************************
A 3D model of a Hammered Metal Cafetiere or French Press. 

  -     Modelled in 3ds Max 2021

Any questions don't hesitate to ask! You can contact me here on CG Trader.
A French press, also known as a cafetière, cafetière à piston, caffettiera a stantuffo, press pot, coffee press, or coffee plunger, is a coffee brewing device, although it can also be used for other tasks. In 1923 Ugo Paolini, an Italian, filed patent documents relating to a tomato juice separator and he developed the idea of making a coffee pot with a press action and a filter. He assigned his 1928 patent to Italian designer Attilio Calimani and Giulio Moneta who filed it in 1929.
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/French_press

description_text:
This is a full dining set with highdefenition models. The models include a set of fruit (apple,banana,grapes), a set of different plates (small,medium,soup), a set of knifes and forks (normal set, steak set, tea spoon), a tea set (cup and pod), a set of differently folded napkins (normal, decorative),  a candle holder as well as a full chess set.
All models are optimized in their poly count and work well with subdivision surface modifiers. The .blend file includes all models textured and with materials and setup in the way shown in the pictures for fast and easy transfer into other scenes. The models can be used as filling elements in complicated scenes but can also hold up very nicely as foreground objects in close up scenes.
The HDRI map included in the .blend file is from HDRI haven and under COO license, meaning it can be used freely as well.

description_text:
Game ready low-poly Kitchen Accessories models with PBR textures for game engines/renderers.
This product is intended for game/real time/background use. This model is not intended for subdivision. Renders done in Marmoset Toolbag 3.
Features:

  - Geometry is triangulated to ensure best shading

  - All materials and objects named appropriately

  - Scaled to approximate real world size

  - Polycount: 52920 tris, 26286 vertices

  - No special plugins needed

  - .obj and .fbx versions exported from Blender 2.83

Textures:

  - Texture resolution: 4096x4096

  - Texture formats: PNG

  - General PBR Metallic/Roughness  textures: BaseColor, Metallic, Roughness, Normal(DirectX), Normal(OpenGL), AO

  - Unity Textures: Albedo, MetallicSmoothness, Normal(OpenGL), AO

  - Unreal Engine 4 textures: BaseColor, OcclusionRoughnessMetallic, Normal(DirectX)

  - PBR Specular/Glossiness textures: Diffuse, Specular, Glossiness, Normal(DirectX), Normal(OpenGL), AO

Substance Painter source files also available in the extra downloads so that you can easily alter the textures as you wish with Substance Painter. The Marmoset Toolbag scene is included. Unity and Unreal Engine 4 projects are included.

description_text:
This small vase is great for any sort of decorative purpose you may have, and is modeled/textured with the utmost quality in mind.
Here is what you get:

  - Hi Poly Model 

  - Low Poly Model 

  - Exported Texture Maps for Most Render Engines

  - 4K jpgs

  - 4K jpgs

  - Position

  - World Space Normals

Just plug in the maps however you need to, and you're good to go!

  - Hi-Poly Model: 

  - 1500 (quads)

  - Model includes variation in silhouette, and warbles to create variation in shape.

  - Low-Poly Model:

  - UV mapped @ 1001 

  - Includes warble information present in the high-poly model 

  - Cusp angle set to 60 degrees

  - Modeled in real-world values (meters)

  - Centered at origin above the ground plane 

  - Frozen Transforms 

  - Squeaky Clean Mesh

If you're looking for the best in quality with the least amount of hassle, you came to the right place!
Extra Notes   - The vase's .obj units are in meters, so you may need to scale according to the unit your application runs in. (ex: Meters to Centimeters would need to scale down by 0.01)

description_text:
LiveJournal (LJ) is a virtual community where Internet users can
keep a blog, journal or diary. LiveJournal is also the name of the free
and open source server software that was designed to run the
LiveJournal virtual community. LiveJournal's blogging features
include those found in similar blogging sites (multiple authors,
commenting, calendars, and polls). However, LiveJournal
differentiates itself from other blogging sites by its WELL-like
features of a self-contained community and some social networking
features similar to other social networking sites.[citation needed]
LiveJournal was started on April 15, 1999 by Brad Fitzpatrick as a
way of keeping his high school friends updated on his activities. In
January 2005, blogging software company Six Apart purchased
Danga Interactive, the company that operated LiveJournal, from
Fitzpatrick.
On December 2, 2007, Six Apart announced it was selling
LiveJournal to SUP, a Russian media company that had been
licensing the LiveJournal brand and software for use in Russia. The
new owners unveiled a plan to upgrade the service, engage with the
LiveJournal community and launch new products for advertisers.
This work would be undertaken by the newly formed American-based
company LiveJournal, Inc.
